Discover Our State

At Mississippi State University, we’re ushering in a new era of education that’s focused on taking care of what matters. We provide an environment where students, faculty and staff can thrive, grow together and understand emerging challenges. That’s because we believe a university should be a place where everyone is welcome. A place that is positive, diverse, open-minded and exciting. A place where today can be enjoyed to the fullest. And where progress for the future is made every single day. 

Explore Our Traditions

Prospective
Undergraduates

We have over 180+ majors to select from to get your bachelor’s degree. Find what interests you and schedule a visit today!

Find Your Major Plan Your Visit

Mississippi State’s support opened the door to research internships in Washington, D.C., Albuquerque, New Mexico, and Liverpool, U.K., along with additional opportunities on campus. Before I arrived at MSU, I’d never imagined traveling the country and world, but all of these experiences were made possible at the university.

— Evan Garrison, Senior Aerospace Engineering/Math Major, Rhodes Scholar, Class of 2027

Hometown: Webb City, Missouri

Prospective
Graduate Students

With over 200 graduate programs, including many distance options, there is an academic program to meet almost anyone’s career goals.
